crossRefs.note: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered…
Fire came out from before Yahweh, and devoured them, and they died before Yahweh.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before Yahweh, and died;
translations.bsb: Now the LORD spoke to Moses after the death of two of Aaron’s sons when they approached the presence of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
translations.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before Jehovah, and died;
